requestB.description:
ONE transparent 96x96 low-resolution pixel-art game sprite: a forceful AIRBORNE DIAGONAL FLYING KICK, key pose B at FULL LEG EXTENSION. Use the supplied approved Ataho v2 images as the EXACT character and pixel-style reference. Preserve his large broad tiger head, wide ivory muzzle and cheek tufts, short broad heavy torso, thick short arms and legs. Reddish-brown jacket with long sleeves over ivory undershirt, brown knotted sash, loose charcoal trousers, wrist wraps, bare ochre tiger paws and ONE striped tail. Keep original coarse pixel clusters and simple shading. Do not redesign him into a tall lean fighter or a detailed illustration.

Three-quarter front camera near the target, looking slightly upward. The compact torso and hips are toward the UPPER LEFT; the striking heel projects diagonally toward the LOWER RIGHT and slightly toward the lens. The same leg is STRAIGHT from hip through knee to ankle: show the connected thigh AND calf silhouette on one clear diagonal, so the leg is visibly extended. Do not hide a folded knee behind an enlarged sole. Keep the leg short and thick like the reference, never long thin human proportions. Heel leads, toes pull back. Turn the bare foot about 35 degrees away from facing the lens: show BOTH its sole at an oblique angle AND its outer edge/top, not a flat frontal paw-pad plate. Foot only modestly larger through perspective, around the head's width. Sole pads are subdued brown-orange, not bright pink or heart-shaped. Keep face readable. Other leg folds behind the hip; both feet off ground; compact fists balance the body. Strong decisive martial pose. Whole character and tail inside canvas with clear transparent margins. No opponent, floor, shadow, text, panel, glow, speed lines, trails or impact effects. NO boots, bottle, armor, extra limbs, second tail or enlarged whole body.

requestA.description:
ONE transparent 96x96 low-resolution pixel-art game sprite, key pose A: AIRBORNE KNEE CHAMBER immediately BEFORE the diagonal full-extension kick in the selected B reference. This is the SAME existing Ataho v2, with B's large broad tiger head, wide ivory muzzle and cheek tufts, short broad heavy torso, thick short arms and legs, brown jacket over ivory undershirt, knotted brown sash, loose charcoal trousers, wrist wraps, bare tiger paws and ONE tail. Keep B's crisp coarse pixel clusters, simple shading and palette. Never make the character taller, leaner, or more detailed.

Treat supplied B as the fixed END key pose. Draw A from EXACTLY B's camera, facing and body angle: keep the head, shoulders, short torso, hips, two fists, folded rear leg, and tail in the same approximate positions and sizes. Do NOT invent a new side view, turn the head, or enlarge the entire body. The main change is the STRIKING LEG: bend its knee and retract the same heel along B's diagonal back toward the hip, tucking the lower leg compactly for a strong loaded kick. Raise that knee in front of the waist/chest without hiding the face. Keep the foot small while retracted. The same sole and outer edge remain oblique to the camera, not a front-facing paw-pad plate. Both feet remain airborne; the rear leg stays folded as in B. Stout compact martial preparation with visible bent hip/knee/ankle, not a standing kick, completed extension or different leg. Brown-orange subdued sole pads, never bright pink. Entire figure fits within the native canvas with transparent margins. No floor, opponent, shadow, words, panel, trails, glow, effects, footwear, bottles, armor, extra limbs or second tail.

reference_images.usage: Selected B is the fixed END pose. Match its exact compact body, head, costume, coarse pixel style, camera, facing, fists, folded rear leg and tail. Draw the immediately preceding chamber pose by BENDING and RETRACTING the same extended leg only, not a different view.
